# Pettifer

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** A crank  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Pettifer is a peculiar, anxious, restless, and small man.

_Sources: [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039)_

## Personality

Mr. Pettifer is an eccentric, short-tempered, and anxious man who often acts out of hasty anger, though he quickly becomes gentle, amiable, and courteous once calmed down. He lives a highly unconventional and careless lifestyle, routinely neglecting household tidiness and dishwashing until compelled to do so. Despite his gruff, stingy reputation and blunt way of speaking, he is capable of warm neighborliness, hospitality, and deep personal affection for his pet parrot.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P7](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0007), [v2 c1 P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008), [v2 c3 P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001), [v2 c3 P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 c3 P9](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0009), [v2 c3 P38](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0038), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 c3 P44](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0044), [v2 c3 P46](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0046)_

## History

Mr. Pettifer moved to Brierley after purchasing Robert Bell's farm, establishing himself as a neighbor to Grey Shutters. He hired young John Henry Carter of Pale Sands to work for him, though his erratic meal schedules and refusal to wash dishes except on wet Sundays caused local gossip. He quickly gained a local reputation for stinginess and eccentricity, openly refusing to hire women or donate to community causes without seeing personal benefit. Following an incident where a Jersey cow got into his crops, Nell Harcourt visited his residence to confess that she had accidentally sold his stray cow; despite his initial outburst of temper, he welcomed her inside, listened courteously, and treated her to tea. During their conversation, he showed interest in her proposed Brierley Village Improvement Society, expressed his affection for his foul-mouthed parrot Nutmeg, and invited Nell to visit him as a friendly neighbor.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 c1 P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P7](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0007), [v2 c1 P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008), [v2 c3 P1](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0001), [v2 c3 P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 c3 P8](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0008), [v2 c3 P16](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0016), [v2 c3 P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035), [v2 c3 P38](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0038), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 c3 P46](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0046)_
